test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question: In India, what kind of wetlands occupy the largest area?
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Inland wetlands.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 3, inland wetlands.**
 
• This is because according to the passage, ***"In India, inland wetlands occupy the largest area, covering about 40 million hectares."***
 
• Therefore,** option 3** is the correct answer.
